TA_proliferation_genes <- c("Tk1", "Nusap1", "Ube2c", "Birc5", "Aurkb", "Cdc6", "Cks2", "Trip", "Chex1", "Pttg1", "Dnmt1", "Nasp", 
                            "Ung", "Cdc7", "Fen1", "Mcm3", "Mcm4", "Mcm5","Mcm6", "Orc1l", "Pcna", "Prim1", "Rfc1", "Rrm1", "Rrm2", 
                            "Top2a", "Mad2l1", "Cenpe", "Bub1", "Ctps", "Dhfr", "Tyms", "Ccna2", "Ccnb1", "Ccne1", "Ccnf", "Cdc20", 
                            "Ddx11", "E2f3", "Mki67", "Pkmyt1", "Plk1", "Timp1", "Cdc25c", "Cenpf", "Mapk13", "Exosc9", "Myb")
DotPlot(Epi, features = TA_proliferation_genes, col.min = 0, col.max = 2) + RotatedAxis() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp."),  # Update size legend title
         color = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg. Exp.")) +  # Update color legend title
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("Epithelial cells-", "Epi", x)) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # Remove y-axis title
  )
